management_steps.details: Oral syrup (250 mg/5 mL, providing 30 mg elemental iron per 5 mL / 6 mg per mL) or elixir (350 mg/5 mL, providing 40 mg elemental iron per 5 mL / 8 mg per mL).
Ferrous gluconate syrup, oral, 2.5 mL daily (provides approx. 15 mg elemental iron) until 6 months of age.
Prophylaxis for infants from 6 weeks if < 2.5 kg at birth.
